_source_note: New class built (Sept 2026) from 52 real Ascension screenshots (Starcaller.docx) plus the big CoA handoff doc for structure/spec identity/passive filler. 4 specs confirmed: Moon Guard (Agility tank, Protection Paladin analog), Sentinel (Agility ranged DPS, Hunter/Elemental hybrid), Moon Priest (Agility healer, Resto Shaman/Disc Priest hybrid), Warden (Agility melee DPS, Havoc DH analog). Mana + Energy dual-resource confirmed via screenshots (Celestial Strike costs Energy; most other spells drain % max Mana). Corrected 2 pre-existing wrong stubs: primary stat was wrongly Intellect (real: Agility), resource was wrongly Mana-only (real: Mana+Energy). Real core mechanic: Scattered Stars, a stacking consumable resource (builds via Starsunder/Huntress Shot/Fan of Knives, consumed by Lunar Lance/Starsweep/Starfire Shot/Trueshot/Umbral Blade for bonus Arcane damage) - not fully modeled as a real stack-count system yet (engine has no generic stacking-buff primitive), flagged per-ability.

abilities.name: Starsweep
abilities.description: Sweep an enemy and all nearby enemies with your astral blade, consuming Scattered Stars to reduce this spell's cooldown.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 20, 4 Mana, melee range, instant, 20 sec cooldown, 'Consumes Scattered Stars. Sweep an enemy and all nearby enemies with your astral blade, dealing 57 Arcane damage. Every Scattered Star consumed reduces the cooldown of this spell by 3 sec.'  CONSUME NOW WIRED: the tooltip's 'Consumes Scattered Stars ... Every Scattered Star consumed reduces the cooldown of this spell by 3 sec' had no engine support, so the description said it consumed stars and nothing happened. 3 of 20 sec is 15% of the cooldown; Frontier's is 4 turns, hence 0.6 turns per star. The payout is cooldown, NOT damage - see combat/abilities.py cooldown_per_stack.

abilities.name: Celestial Aegis
abilities.description: Envelop yourself with celestial magic, reducing damage taken. Only 1 Aegis spell can be active at a time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 30, 'Drains 30% Maximum Mana. Reducing your damage taken by 25% for 10 sec.' Part of the mutually-exclusive Aegis family shared across specs. DAMAGE_TAKEN_PCT IN AN ABILITY'S stat_mods IS A FRACTION, NOT PERCENT POINTS. This was authored in points, so the engine read it as -2500% and floored every incoming hit at 1 damage for the buff's whole duration - a flat immunity, not a mitigation cooldown. Character.take_damage adds get_status_stat_mod('damage_taken_pct') UNDIVIDED, while the physical_/magic_ variants four lines away ARE divided by 100, so the convention is per-key with no naming rule. Verified: -0.10 takes a 1000 hit to 900, -10 takes it to 1. 41 of the game's 51 abilities carrying this key already use the fraction form (warrior_shield_wall -0.4, druid_barkskin -0.2).

abilities.name: Lunar Eclipse

abilities._implementation_note: The real mechanic empowers the NEXT 'Lunar Phase' spell cast, not a flat self-buff - this engine doesn't have a 'next-cast-consumes-this' primitive shared cleanly across many different spells yet, modeled as a short self-buff window instead.

abilities._implementation_note: The per-Aspect unique effect isn't dynamically modeled yet (this ability's effect always resolves as flat weapon damage regardless of which Aspect is active) - real per-Aspect branching needs a proper conditional-effect dispatch, same class of gap as the Weapon Engraving procs on Runemaster.

abilities.name: Celestial Impact

abilities._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Ground stomp: Arcane AoE + stun.' Real numbers not confirmed via a dedicated screenshot.  Removed dead flag stat_mod(s) ['stunned']: nothing in the engine reads them. The real mechanism is the ability-level is_stun flag, which this ability already carries. Keeping them was the is_aoe trap waiting to happen: data that looks like the mechanism and is not. This engine has exactly one incapacitate mechanic, is_stun, with no separate silence or root category (see StatusEffect.is_stun).

abilities.name: Prayer of Elune
abilities.description: Heal up to several allies and dispel harmful magic from them.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 30, Sentinel(1) tag, 'healing up to 12 allies within 40 yds for 173, and dispel 1 harmful magic effect from them.' Moon Priest's real party heal+cleanse (tag conflict noted but mechanic clearly belongs here per the handoff doc).  Its description says 'heal up to several allies and dispel harmful magic from them' and it carried NO dispel_type, which remove_debuff_by_dispel_type treats as a guaranteed no-match - an ability with no configured school finds nothing, full stop (see that method's docstring). So the dispel half never happened. Now 'magic', the school the description names.

The real mechanism is the ability-level is_stun flag, which this ability already carries. Keeping them was the is_aoe trap waiting to happen: data that looks like the mechanism and is not. Removed dead flag stat_mod(s) ['stealthed']: nothing in the engine reads them. The real mechanism is the ability-level is_stun flag, which this ability already carries - EXCEPT IT DOES NOT, so this was a stun that never stunned.
